banner.title: unifi-dns
banner.tagline: Writes internal hostnames into the UniFi gateway's DNS, so LAN clients resolve them to the internal Gateway.

art.about: internal DNS records written into a router from cluster objects
art.title: How unifi-dns writes LAN records

explainer.title: LAN names from Gateway and Service objects

steps.title: Key
steps.text: ExternalSecret unifi-dns maps the UniFi API key and host from 1Password item unifi into Secret unifi-dns-secret for the webhook.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: external-dns reads HTTPRoutes and Services and takes each record target from the parent Gateway's annotation.
steps.scene: a magnifier over a route map

steps.title: Write
steps.text: The webhook container writes records to the UniFi controller, each paired with a TXT record that names the owner main.
steps.scene: a router with a cable into a list of records

steps.title: Prune
steps.text: Owned records with no source are removed. A record without its TXT twin is hand-made, and it stays.
steps.scene: a list with one line struck through
